name: Scarlet Smiling Skull
source:
What will you do if you see someone that you admire die in front of you? Will you go look for the truth? Can you handle the truth?!
Scarlet Smiling Skull is a unique visual novel with stylized visual, relate-able topics, and meaningful choices!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/930700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如果你看到你敬佩的人死在你面前你会怎么做？你会去寻找真相吗？你能接受事实吗？！
《猩红微笑骷髅》是一部独特的视觉小说，具有风格化的视觉效果、相关的主题和有意义的选择！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/930700/]Steam[/url]]
